properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 30 at 6:25PM CDT until July 31 at 12:30AM CDT by NWS Aberdeen SD
properties.description:
FFWABR

The National Weather Service in Aberdeen has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northwestern Big Stone County in west central Minnesota...
Southwestern Traverse County in west central Minnesota...
Northeastern Day County in northeastern South Dakota...
Southeastern Marshall County in northeastern South Dakota...
Southwestern Roberts County in northeastern South Dakota...

* Until 1230 AM CDT Friday.

* At 625 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3.5 inches of rain
have fallen. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Sisseton, Agency Village, Browns Valley, Wilmot, Enemy Swim
Housing, Beardsley, Peever, Grenville, Barry, Peever Flats Housing,
Dakota Connection & Casino, Lake Traverse Housing Units, Finley
Heights Housing, Yankeetown, Traverse Country Park, Bonanza Grove,
Lake Traverse, Rainbow Island, Rudebusch Corner and Big Stone Lake.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued July 30 at 8:05PM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Nueces River Near Three Rivers affecting Live Oak County.

Nueces River Near Tilden affecting McMullen County.

For the Nueces River...including Tilden, Three Rivers...Major
flooding is forecast.

- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 39.2 feet
tomorrow evening.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 39.0
feet on 10/21/2013.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Even 6 inches of fast-moving flood water can knock you off your feet
and a depth of 2 feet will float your car. Never try to walk, swim,
or drive through such swift water. If you come upon flood waters,
stop, turn around and go another way.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/crp.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued July 31 at 12:10AM EDT until July 31 at 1:15AM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
SMWTBW

The National Weather Service in Ruskin has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Tarpon Springs to Suwannee River FL out 20
NM...
Waters from Tarpon Springs to Suwannee River FL out 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 115 AM EDT.

* At 1210 AM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from Aripeka to 33 nm west of Bayport to 42 nm southwest
of Suwannee River, moving southeast at 25 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, frequent lightning, and heavy downpours. Make sure
all on board are wearing life jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
Hernando Beach, Aripeka, Anclote Key, Port Richey, Bayport, and
Tarpon Springs.
